title: TLS 1.2 and Okta
description:
### Please confirm

- [x] I have searched existing issues to check if an issue already exists for my feature request.

### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

TLS 1.3 is not yet supported by OKTA, a somewhat large provider.  The option `LXD_INSECURE_TLS=true` was removed some time ago. 
Is it possible to have this option?

### Describe the solution you'd like

option to support OIDC providers limited to TLS 1.2

### Describe alternatives you've considered

setting up a proxy server to proxy 1.3 to 1.2

### Additional context

_No response_
author: smcavoy-ws

comments.author: simondeziel
comments.body:
> TLS 1.3 is not yet supported by OKTA, a somewhat large provider.

A somewhat worrying combo: large provide of authentication solution not supporting TLS 1.3 :/

It was accepted as proper RFC in August 2018. Are you aware of an ETA for them to support it?

> Is it possible to have this option?

`5.21/*` snaps still support this, would that be an OK workaround for you?

comments.author: tomponline
comments.body: I've asked around internally and apparently the okta access gateway supports TLS 1.3, if that helps.

comments.author: smcavoy-ws
